name: llmctl-marketplace
description: .llmctl — personal agent steering: coding, research, authoring, ops, and product.

metadata.description: .llmctl — personal agent steering: coding, research, authoring, ops, and product.

plugins.name: llmctl-baseline
plugins.description: Baseline for efficient and effective AI agent usage. Encourage usage of sub-agents, adopt a more concise output style, and more. Comes with domain-neutral planning, exploration and execution agents, research, troubleshooting, and diagramming steering.

plugins.name: llmctl-design
plugins.description: Collaborative design work; direction-setting, colour, typography and presentation skills, plus layout, identity and data-visualisation practice.

plugins.name: llmctl-ops
plugins.description: Confidently hand off infrastructure work. Helm, Kubernetes and OpenTofu/Terraform skills, path-scoped conventions, and cloud and IaC documentation connectors.

plugins.name: llmctl-product
plugins.description: Epic and feature PRD authoring, plus product-manager and UX-expert agents. Very Barebones!

plugins.name: llmctl-python
plugins.description: Ensure modern pythonic development with source-authoring standards, single-file script discipline, and modern uv, ruff and ty project tooling.

plugins.name: llmctl-travel
plugins.description: Take the busy-work out of travel planning. Destination timing checks against holidays and major events, entry requirements, itineraries, and flight, hotel, ferry and stay search connectors.

plugins.name: llmctl-workflow
plugins.description: Consistent code delivery from AI agents. Test-driven development, git worktrees, merge-conflict resolution, receiving code review and lint pipelines, plus a code-reviewer agent.
